instruction: Repair {{symbol}} in {{entry}}. Split on Unicode whitespace outside single or double quotes. Remove matching quote delimiters; adjacent quoted/unquoted portions form one token, and empty quotes preserve an empty token. A backslash escapes the next character outside single quotes, including inside double quotes; inside single quotes it is literal. Refuse unmatched quotes or a final escape with Err. Whitespace-only input returns an empty vector.
